description: The 24 shared topics for New York open data, with how many datasets and portals each has in the harvested index, and the share of datasets with at least one topic. Topics are built from the categories, tags and departments the portals already use; a dataset can have several. Use a topic id with search_datasets. Also links the crosswalk (each portal label and its topics), published with every index.

portal.description: Count one portal only: source_id or part of a portal name
